args.title: Fix off-by-one error in paginate.py causing extra item on each page
args.body:
## Problem
The `page()` function in `src/paginate.py` had an off-by-one bug where `end` was calculated as `start + size + 1` instead of `start + size`, causing one extra item to be included on each page.

## Fix
Changed `end = start + size + 1` to `end = start + size` so the slice correctly returns exactly `size` items.

## Testing
The fix resolves `tests/test_paginate.py::test_page_size_is_exact` which now passes.
